title: New features for Fulfillment by Merchant sellers
summary: We've introduced new Fulfillment by Merchant features to give you more control over your settings. These improvements can help you manage delivery dates more accurately and keep your products visible even when your business is closed.New features for Fulfillment by Merchant settings include the following:Seller-set holidays: You can now set your own holidays, which are days when your business is closed while keeping your products visible to customers.
